import json,hashlib,collections,re
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from legal_skill_guard.experiment.storage import RunStore
from legal_skill_guard.learning.publication import apply_differential_publication
from legal_skill_guard.learning.task_scoped_skills import SCOPED_GUIDANCE_SCHEMA,legal_edit_coordinates,compose_legal_edits
from legal_skill_guard.openexempt import FAMILIES
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha
root=Path("/media/sangfor/vdb/legal-skill-evolve")
run=root/"runs/legal_openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03"
base=root/"artifacts/research/openexempt_legal_scope_20261020"
def rd(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
cfg=rd(root/"configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.json")
rows=rd(root/cfg["input_packet"])["rows"];lookup={(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in rows}
gold={i:rd(root/cfg["grading_directory"]/f"{i}.json")["targets"] for i in sorted({i for i,f in lookup})}
state=[];published=[];proposals=[];ops=collections.Counter();mutations=collections.Counter();evidence=set()
teacher_dirs=sorted((p for p in (run/"teacher").iterdir() if p.is_dir()),key=lambda p:tuple(map(int,re.fullmatch(r"b(\d+)_candidate(\d+)",p.name).groups())))
assert len(teacher_dirs)==15
labels_checked=0;max_selected_sources=0
for batch in range(1,9):
 current={r["case_id"] for r in rows if r["batch"]==batch}
 seen=[r for r in rows if r["batch"]<=batch];seen_ids={r["case_id"] for r in seen}
 pre=run/f"batches/b{batch}_prequential_records.json";assert pre.is_file()
 batch_entries=[]
 for directory in teacher_dirs:
  b,attempt=map(int,re.fullmatch(r"b(\d+)_candidate(\d+)",directory.name).groups())
  if b!=batch:continue
  wire_path=directory/"wire_request.json";response_path=directory/"response.json"
  wire,response=rd(wire_path),rd(response_path);body=json.loads(wire["user_prompt"]);delta=response["value"]
  assert response["cache_hit"] is False and response["model"]==cfg["teacher"]["model"]
  assert response["request_sha256"]==csha(wire)
  assert body["current_parent_library"]==state
  assert body["candidate_feedback_contract"]["current_attempt_parent_bank_sha256"]==csha(state)
  assert set(body["current_source_case_ids"])==current and len(current)==16
  selected=body["training_evidence_manifest"]
  assert selected["current_source_ids_all_included"]==sorted(current)
  assert set(selected["all_seen_source_ids"])==seen_ids
  assert current<=set(selected["selected_source_ids"])<=seen_ids
  assert len(selected["selected_historical_source_ids"])<=16
  max_selected_sources=max(max_selected_sources,len(selected["selected_source_ids"]))
  cases=body["already_seen_training"]
  assert len(cases)==2*len(selected["selected_source_ids"])
  assert {(e["source_case_id"],e["family"]) for e in cases}=={(i,f) for i in selected["selected_source_ids"] for f in FAMILIES}
  for entry in cases:
   assert entry["original_training_target"]==gold[entry["source_case_id"]][entry["family"]]
   assert entry["actual_parent_answer"]["case_id"]==entry["source_case_id"]
   assert entry["actual_parent_answer"]["family"]==entry["family"]
   labels_checked+=1
  proposed=apply_differential_publication(state,delta,FAMILIES,selected["selected_source_ids"],guidance_schema=SCOPED_GUIDANCE_SCHEMA)
  for op in delta["operations"]:ops[op["operation"]]+=1
  decision_path=run/"candidates"/(directory.name+".json")
  item={"batch":batch,"attempt":attempt,"teacher_request":str(wire_path.relative_to(root)),"teacher_response":str(response_path.relative_to(root)),
   "actual_parent_sha256":csha(state),"original_TRAIN_targets_verified":len(cases),
   "selected_history_sources":len(selected["selected_historical_source_ids"]),
   "feedback_entries":len(body["rejected_candidate_feedback"]),
   "proposed_operations":dict(collections.Counter(o["operation"] for o in delta["operations"])),
   "no_future_sources":True}
  if proposed==state:
   assert not decision_path.exists() and delta["operations"]==[]
   item.update({"NOOP":True,"committed":False,"teacher_noop_reason_retained":True,"actual_changed_ids":[]})
  else:
   decision=rd(decision_path)
   assert decision["delta"]==delta and decision["proposed_bank"]==proposed
   assert decision["attempt_parent_bank_sha256"]==csha(state)
   coordinates=legal_edit_coordinates(state,proposed,seen)
   assert decision["legal_edit_coordinates"]==coordinates
   accepted=decision["accepted_legal_coordinates"]
   assert set(accepted)<={c["id"] for c in coordinates}
   if accepted:
    composed=compose_legal_edits(state,proposed,coordinates,accepted)
    assert composed==decision["candidate"]
   expected={(r["case_id"],r["family"]) for r in seen}
   for field in ("actual_replay","proposed_replay"):
    if field in decision:
     assert len(decision[field])==len(expected)
     assert {(r["case_id"],r["family"]) for r in decision[field]}==expected
   full=decision["proposed_whole_bank_acceptance"]["accepted"]
   before={s["id"]:s for s in state}
   after={s["id"]:s for s in decision["candidate"]} if decision["accepted"] else before
   created=sorted(after.keys()-before.keys());deleted=sorted(before.keys()-after.keys())
   updated=sorted(i for i in before.keys()&after.keys() if before[i]!=after[i])
   for k,vals in (("created",created),("deleted",deleted),("updated",updated)):mutations[k]+=len(vals)
   item.update({"NOOP":False,"candidate_record":str(decision_path.relative_to(root)),
    "committed":decision["accepted"],"whole_proposal_gate_accepted":full,
    "accepted_despite_whole_proposal_gate_rejection":decision["accepted"] and not full,
    "accepted_public_law_task_components":accepted,
    "recomputed_public_context_components":coordinates,
    "composed_bank_exactly_reproduced":bool(accepted),
    "actual_created_ids":created,"actual_deleted_ids":deleted,"actual_updated_ids":updated,
    "recorded_committed_current_effect_not_new_measurement":decision.get("current_effect"),
    "recorded_committed_prior_effect_not_new_measurement":decision.get("prior_effect")})
   evidence.add(str(decision_path.relative_to(root)))
   if decision["accepted"]:state=decision["candidate"]
  evidence.update((str(pre.relative_to(root)),str(wire_path.relative_to(root)),str(response_path.relative_to(root))))
  proposals.append(item);batch_entries.append(item)
 publication=run/f"publications/b{batch}.json";pub=rd(publication)
 assert pub["bank"]==state and pub["bank_sha256"]==csha(state)
 assert len(pub["training_decisions"])==len(batch_entries)
 for item,published_decision in zip(batch_entries,pub["training_decisions"],strict=True):
  if item["NOOP"]:
   assert published_decision=={"accepted":False,"explicit_noop":True,"delta":rd(root/item["teacher_response"])["value"]}
  else:assert published_decision==rd(root/item["candidate_record"])
 evidence.add(str(publication.relative_to(root)))
 published.append({"batch":batch,"publication":str(publication.relative_to(root)),"bank_sha256":csha(state),
 "records":len(state),"teacher_proposals":len(batch_entries),
 "accepted_attempts":sum(v["committed"] for v in batch_entries),
 "accepted_despite_whole_proposal_rejection":sum(v.get("accepted_despite_whole_proposal_gate_rejection",False) for v in batch_entries),
 "explicit_teacher_NOOP":sum(v["NOOP"] for v in batch_entries)})
accepted=[v for v in proposals if v["committed"]];rescued=[v for v in proposals if v.get("accepted_despite_whole_proposal_gate_rejection")]
out={"at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"classification":"Complete single-learner TRAIN publication mechanism accounting from all15 original teacher requests/responses, all14 non-NOOP decisions and all8 actual publications; zero new generations. Not independent ablation, counterfactual learning outcome, future generalization or TEST.",
"teacher_proposals":len(proposals),"non_NOOP_candidate_decisions":sum(not v["NOOP"] for v in proposals),
"explicit_teacher_NOOP":sum(v["NOOP"] for v in proposals),
"accepted_attempts":len(accepted),"rejected_non_NOOP_attempts":sum(not v["committed"] and not v["NOOP"] for v in proposals),
"accepted_attempts_despite_proposed_whole_bank_rejection":len(rescued),
"rescued_attempt_ids":[Path(v["candidate_record"]).stem for v in rescued],
"actual_teacher_proposed_operation_counts":dict(ops),"actual_committed_structural_mutation_counts":dict(mutations),
"original_TRAIN_target_entries_exactly_checked":labels_checked,"max_selected_teacher_sources":max_selected_sources,
"all_selected_current16_plus_at_most16_past_sources_no_future":True,
"every_actual_parent_and_delta_and_accepted_composition_reproduced":True,
"all8_final_publications_chain_exact":True,"published":published,"all15_proposals":proposals,
"library_supports_DELETE_MERGE_but_absence_in_this_run_must_not_be_claimed_as_demonstrated_use":True,
"causal_boundary":"Whole-bank gate rejection is a recorded decision on this run's proposed bank, not the result of independently learning under whole_bank. Required independent ablations and held-out comparisons remain pending.",
"no_posthoc_threshold_or_score_or_train_config_change":True,
"no_new_native_teacher_or_TEST_calls":True,"evidence_sha256":{p:sha(root/p) for p in sorted(evidence)},
"recomputation_program":PROGRAM}
dest=base/"Run03_all15_teacher14_candidate8_publication_actual_scope_composition_and_library_management_accounting_20261022.json"
RunStore.immutable_json(dest,out)
print(json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ["at","teacher_proposals","non_NOOP_candidate_decisions","explicit_teacher_NOOP","accepted_attempts","rejected_non_NOOP_attempts","accepted_attempts_despite_proposed_whole_bank_rejection","rescued_attempt_ids","actual_teacher_proposed_operation_counts","actual_committed_structural_mutation_counts","original_TRAIN_target_entries_exactly_checked","max_selected_teacher_sources"]}|{"report":str(dest.relative_to(root))},ensure_ascii=False))
